list: Display cabinets are the most common equipment in Propeller Paradise. Its original name was 'Volvort Kochinski Interactive Display Unit', but nobody has called it that ever since Ferne said it looked like a giant peanut.

Cultivation rack designed to ensure freshness, equipped with ultraviolet lights. The frame transforms into the planting pot, for quicker ripening. Not to be used for martial arts practice, and be careful not to pick the wrong stuff.

The only reason for this floor's existence is to prevent people from falling from the sky. 'Oh please, this is Propeller Paradise. Who's looking down at the ground here? Who cares what it looks like?'

Six hands of different lengths spin on a 3D globe. No one knows how to read them. Human domains, too, become 3D when the sky lies beneath the feet, defining a new era of 'cubism'. But who needs the time, as long as it points out the future?

Telescope developed by Nasti. Unlike ordinary telescopes, it projects the image on the ground directly, sparing the user the need to look into an eyepiece. Everyone in the sky has something that they want people on the ground to see.

Hard carpet recreating massive patterns that appeared overnight in the Handofshire suburbs. 'Whether wilderness circles were a prank or not, it's worth asking the question: What would visitors from beyond Terra expect from us?
Preparation counter with tomato bouillon, pepper grinders, and hover-cups. The utensils and food are unfamiliar, but the joy of eating remains a constant even in the strange future.

Wall consisting of highly complex glass lenses, refracting the sky like a periscope. Gordon refuses to simulate the clouds through wallpapers and panoramic displays. 'Like we haven't had enough fake sky!'

Dining table inspired by airships and built from aviation-grade materials. It is inclusive and cutting-edge, just like true Columbians. It does not know what all the weird trinkets inside it are about, but they are worth their weight.
theme: A recreation of a floating pod from Propeller Paradise. Advanced devices are often innovative in form. Please carefully read the manual, and don't guess their functions. Insurance is recommended to protect against damage caused by improper use.

list:
You witnessed an Air Expo Columbia that was hard to define.
The big papers all took a guess at the accident's cause, but sadly neither 'marketing stunt' nor 'political conspiracy' would get eyes on the front page. The residents of the autonomous district poke themselves out of their offices, silently watching the 'tree' floating in the sky with pure curiosity.
During the Unrealized Realities event, obtain the free Operator Skybox

Don't doubt your eyes. The 'foil-wrapped potato' in front of you really is the Chief Executive of Propeller Paradise.
Arrogance, ambition, and absurd fantasies are crammed into Skybox's pride and joy—that is, his equipment—brewing up the next big bang that promises to shatter the rules.
During the Unrealized Realities event, spend 4000 Dr Oxygen

Congratulations on breaking the winning streak record! These four thousand bottle caps with 'One more bottle' on them will be your lucky charms as you fly into the future.
No need to worry, you're not getting addicted to soda, you're getting addicted to the SKY!
Complete all stages in [Air Expo Columbia] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

Does it represent contemporary art, or environmentalism? Is what happened on it a conspiracy cut short, or a tale only fowls could listen to?
You have watched it grow from a seed to the luxuriant tree it is now. You may look forward to seeing what sort of fruit it bears.
Complete all the content in [Maintenance Checklist] and collect the rewards

With your aid, all the exhibits had smooth lift-offs.
It's hard to say if these baubles floating in the sky will be swapped out in a few weeks or not. It's hardly unusual. Just hold on to the memories of novel experiences that make your head spin. No need to remember the rest.
During the Unrealized Realities event, deploy Operators on Levitatable Zones a total of 50 times

Suggesting your friends familiarize themselves with life in the sky was a wise decision. You have shown how your gaze is locked onto the future.
'Wait a sec, you can't bring such a large party even if you flash your medals! This is Columbia's most cutting-edge scientific park, not a teambuilding funhouse for a pharma corps!'
Clear UR-EX-3 with a 3-star rating with at least 4 Powerful Balloons remaining on the battlefield

You've jumped up and down on a small experimental platform, learning that these unremarkable balloons are quite reliable. Seemingly.
The futuristic airships are packed full of eager tourists, while you crouch by the retro area's hot air balloons to warm your hands. Nobody expects you and your 'hand warmers' to break through the Starpod.
Complete all stages in [Exodus from Columbia] on Challenge Mode

You witnessed a few friends of yours light a spark aboard Propeller Paradise.
It can burn everything away, but also inspire hope. While those two possibilities are still undetermined, this park can escape via the flames spouting out of its engines.
Clear UR-6 with a 3-star rating, and have no Operators be defeated by 'Liberated Trees'

'There might just be a flying tree in Columbia's future!'
—Writing on the packaging of a floating botanical unit made by a company imitating Rhine Lab
Clear UR-8 with a 3-star rating, and have no more than 8 Operators be defeated by Væla of Convallis's [Return to Oblivion]

You have heard the mutters of an elderly Banshee.
In the Convallis, sharp, grudge-filled cries and grieving whistles waft through the air like mist. Lost travelers lean against trees covered in bone fragments, the crude branches at their backs seemingly throbbing with a red-hot pulse.
set:
A set of engraved medals that record the rise and fall of Columbia's Propeller Paradise.
Where trees and fowls roost, we can find shelter.
